newsitem.title: USA: Wash.-Canada 500 KV line seen down until next week.
newsitem.headline: Wash.-Canada 500 KV line seen down until next week.

text.p: The 500 kilovolt Raver-Schultz transmission line, which runs from Snohomish County, Wash., to the Canadian border, could be down for another week, Bonneville Power Administration (BPA) said Tuesday.
A BPA spokeswoman said power into B.C. Hydro's system has been limited, but most transmissions have been re-routed to other lines.
The line, part of BPA's transmission system, has been down since late last week due to damage during an ice storm.
One of the line's three conductors may not be replaced until August, but the other two have been secured and once restored will enable the line to operate fully, the spokeswoman said.
